capabilities: Narrate notes or selections as streamed audio and save them as WAV files
Transcribe microphone dictation into the note at the cursor
Generate dialogue scripts from prose with AI character detection
Narrate multi-character scripts with a different voice per character
Preview voices and configure models, output folder, and API keys
extras: Freemium: free plan gives 2,500 narrated words and 10 voices per month; paid plans are $9 or $24 monthly. Microphone transcription requires the Obsidian desktop app, and the speech service can take a minute or more to warm up after inactivity.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read notes aloud as audio or to transcribe spoken words into a note at the cursor.

requires.name: OpenRouter API key (AI script generation only)
Scribe or Author subscription for full voices and larger word allowances

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that streams AI-narrated audio from notes, saves WAV files, and adds dictation and multi-voice character scripts.
